items.name: Zygarde Cell
items.description: Zygarde Cells can assemble and disassemble to create different forms of Zygarde. You can carry {0} Zygarde Cells at a time.

items.name: Dragon Scale
items.description: A scale that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is very tough and inflexible.

items.name: Sinnoh Stone
items.description: A special stone originally found in the Sinnoh region that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is very tough and has a beautiful sheen.

items.name: Unova Stone
items.description: A rare stone that originates from the Unova region that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is known for its intertwined black-and-white appearance.

items.name: King's Rock
items.description: A rock that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It looks like a crown.

items.name: Metal Coat
items.description: A coating that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a special metallic film.

items.name: Gimmighoul Coins
items.description: A coin with a mysterious air. It seems to have originated in the Paldea region.

items.name: Sweet Apple
items.description:
A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally sweet.

Apples can be found near PokéStops that have an active Mossy Lure Module.

items.name: Tart Apple
items.description:
A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally tart.

Apples can be found near PokéStops that have an active Mossy Lure Module.

items.name: Syrupy Apple
items.description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally syrupy.

items.name: Sun Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It burns as red as the evening sun.

items.name: Glacial Lure Module
items.description: A frosty Lure Module that attracts Pokémon for 30 minutes, especially ones that love the cold. It can also cause some Pokémon to evolve.

items.name: Magnetic Lure Module
items.description: An electronic Lure Module that attracts Pokémon for 30 minutes, especially ones that possess a magnetic field. It can also cause some Pokémon to evolve.

items.name: Mossy Lure Module
items.description: A natural Lure Module that attracts Pokémon for 30 minutes, especially ones that love mossy scents. It can also cause some Pokémon to evolve.

items.name: Rainy Lure Module
items.description: A wet Lure Module that attracts Pokémon for 30 minutes, especially ones that love the rain. It can also cause some Pokémon to evolve.

items.name: Upgrade
items.description: A transparent device that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It was produced by Silph Co.
